properties.title: The domain reaches the Brazil–Malvinas Confluence
properties.message: If an edge of the domain lies across the Brazil–Malvinas Confluence, expect trouble: strong currents are fine at a boundary, but chaotic flow, with eddies in every direction, is not.
properties.instruction: Check where the Brazil–Malvinas Confluence meets the domain's edges. Take the whole structure into the domain, or move the edge well away from it.

references.title: Expert interview 1: Coral Triangle & Benguela Upwelling

evidence.quote: What’s problematic is chaotic flow—eddies in every direction.
If the current system includes something like a retroflection, that feature really needs to be included within the domain—placing a boundary right at a retroflection usually leads to trouble.
